title: Towards Understanding the Training of GFlowNets: A Theoretical Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2610.13711v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) learn policies that sample discrete objects in proportion to a positive reward. They are trained by minimizing balance objectives, whose exact satisfaction guarantees correct sampling. However, a comprehensive theory linking nonzero balance loss and approximate stationarity to sampling accuracy, especially under evolving sampling distributions and backward policies, is still lacking. To bridge this gap, we develop a unified theory for Flow Matching, Detailed Balance, and Trajectory Balance in this regime. We first bound terminal symmetric KL by the square root of the expected balance loss. Then, we show that approximate stationarity controls this distribution error up to a tangent-space residual measuring parameterization incompleteness. translated_title: 迈向理解GFlowNets的训练：一个理论视角
translated_abstract: 生成流网络（GFlowNets）学习以与正奖励成比例的方式采样离散对象的策略。它们通过最小化平衡目标来训练，精确满足平衡目标可以保证正确的采样。然而，将非零平衡损失和近似平稳性与采样精度联系起来的系统性理论，尤其是在采样分布和反向策略不断演化的情形下，仍然缺乏。为了弥合这一差距，我们为该情形下的流匹配、细致平衡和轨迹平衡建立了一个统一理论。我们首先用期望平衡损失的平方根来约束终端对称KL散度。然后，我们证明近似平稳性可以控制这种分布误差，误差由一个衡量参数化不完备性的切空间残差给出。最后，我们在固定或受控采样，以及固定、平衡训练或独立更新的反向策略条件下，建立了有限时间收敛性。在标准假设下……
tldr: 该论文为GFlowNets的流匹配、细致平衡和轨迹平衡三种训练目标建立了首个统一理论框架，用期望平衡损失定量刻画了采样分布误差，并证明了在多种采样分布与反向策略设置下的有限时间收敛保证。
en_tdlr: This paper develops the first unified theoretical framework for Flow Matching, Detailed Balance, and Trajectory Balance in GFlowNets, quantitatively bounding sampling distribution error by the expected balance loss and establishing finite-time convergence guarantees under various sampling and backward policy settings.
